name: MovScript
description: MovScript runtime agent package for agent providers that support skills, MCP servers, or provider-native plugin registries.

notes: Use claude mcp add or the generated .mcp.json projection.
Use openclaw plugins install --link with the generated OpenClaw plugin package.
Import the generated Worker Agent export into Harness.
Merge the generated mcp.json into ~/.workbuddy/mcp.json or paste it in WorkBuddy MCP settings.
Merge the generated mcp.json into ~/Library/Application Support/Trae/User/mcp.json on macOS or paste it in Trae MCP settings.
